name: Ben Tre food guide
summary: Coconut candy is warm at the kiln, coconut milk and sugar. Lunch on Cồn Phụng is the garden table, and town breakfast is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice.
body: Start at the kiln. Kẹo dừa is a soft candy of coconut milk and sugar, or, on the other account, coconut milk, maltose, and yellow cane sugar. Later pieces take durian, peanut, cacao, or pandan. Eat it warm, or take the wrapped pieces home.

The Cồn Phụng lunch is đuông dừa fried in butter, cá tai tượng chiên xù, xôi chiên phồng, lẩu mắm, cơm trái dừa, and tép rang dừa. The grove lunch is also creamy coconut rice, coconut-braised shrimp, and a light salad of củ hủ dừa. The town boat adds goat steamed with perilla, chicken hotpot with giang leaf, and apple snail with green pepper.

Breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4 is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice. The dinner bowl of the same noodle is pork, shrimp, a quail egg, lime, and cilantro. Keep both plates. Inland, bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng and bánh phồng Sơn Đốc are the craft sweets. The bowl next door is hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho.
specialtiesLead: Coconut candy, the puffed sticky rice, the crisp river fish, honey tea, and a young coconut have a photograph. The other plates are named with them.

sections.heading: Cồn Phụng kitchens
paragraphs: Coconut candy is boiled, cut, and wrapped on Cồn Phụng, with rice paper and honey tea on the same ground.

spots.name: Cồn Phụng kitchens
spots.caption: Wrapping coconut candy in the Cồn Phụng workshop
spots.note: The boil, the cut, and the wrap. One operator prints 07:30–18:00. Hours: Check on arrival. Price: Check on arrival.

sections.heading: The garden lunch
paragraphs: These are the other plates on the Cồn Phụng lunch, the grove lunch, and the town-boat garden. The puffed sticky rice and the crisp river fish are photographed above.

sections.heading: Mỹ Lồng and Sơn Đốc
paragraphs: Bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng and bánh phồng Sơn Đốc were listed together as national intangible heritage on 30 October 2018. Grill either one, or carry it home. The yards run all year and longer near Tết.

sections.heading: In town
paragraphs: In town, bánh ướt comes with a sweet fish sauce, bánh xèo is the coconut-milk pancake, and bún riêu is the afternoon bowl. Chuối đập nước cốt dừa is the snack after Hồ Trúc Giang.

sections.heading: Tea and coconut water
paragraphs: Honey tea and a young coconut are photographed above. Dừa nước is the nipa drink at the garden stop.

sections.heading: Chợ Bến Tre
paragraphs: Chợ Bến Tre sits on the cycle past the Ben Tre River, before the short ferry to Cù lao Long. After the lake, the night walk is chợ đêm Bến Tre and khu phố chợ Phú Khương.

spots.name: Ben Tre Market
spots.caption: The southern side of Chợ Bến Tre, from the bridge
spots.note: The day market on the way toward the river. The night market is a different walk. Hours: Check on arrival.

sections.heading: A bowl in My Tho
paragraphs: The bowl next door is hủ tiếu Mỹ Tho, a different plate from the Ben Tre breakfast.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4 is hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice. The dinner bowl is a different plate of the same noodle.

seoTitle: Ben Tre food — coconut candy and the garden lunch
seoDescription: Kẹo dừa at the kiln, xôi chiên phồng on the Cồn Phụng lunch, and hủ tiếu with a pork-pâté slice in town.
